instruction: Navigate to the 2020 playoff scores on NFL.com.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from NFL.com homepage to the 2020 playoff scores page. Uses existing evaluator function is_expected_url_pattern_match to verify the URL matches the 2020 playoff pattern (any week of 2020 playoffs is acceptable). Similar complexity to original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to navigate to 2020 playoff scores on NFL.com
Getter (active_url_from_accessTree) correctly extracts the active tab URL from accessibility tree
Metric function (is_expected_url_pattern_match) correctly performs regex pattern matching using re.search()
URL pattern 'https://www\.nfl\.com/scores/2020/post' is semantically correct - matches the base 2020 playoff scores URL

Pattern is appropriately flexible: using re.search() (not re.match()) allows matching URLs like '/scores/2020/post', '/scores/2020/post/1', '/scores/2020/post/wild-card', etc., which aligns with metadata stating 'any week of 2020 playoffs is acceptable'
Data flow is correct: URL getter → regex pattern matcher → success if pattern found in URL
No edge case issues: evaluator will return 0.0 if URL is None or pattern doesn't match, which is appropriate
